requirements.title: Scope and ownership
requirements.statement: Aegaeon owns identity, coarse membership and delegated authority. Business records and business-object decisions remain with the application. Organizations belong to one Environment and one authorization domain; Team/Tenant operator privileges remain separate. Targets resolve to one domain.
requirements.actor: Aegaeon AS/OP/own RS and organization authority; external consumers only where explicitly named

requirements.title: Permanent subject ownership
requirements.statement: Bind memberships to permanent internal user ownership and issuer/subject history. A selected UUID subject profile applies to every new-account path, including upstream provisioning; authorized import preserves existing subjects after collision/history checks. Never infer identity from email or silently rename existing subjects.

requirements.title: External organization identifiers
requirements.statement: Accept caller-selected opaque external IDs, 1–256 UTF-8 bytes without control characters, compared exactly. Resolve identifier under the authenticated Environment and target domain; return that same external value on APIs and tokens. Preserve deletion tombstones. Neither an equal ID nor a guessed ID authorizes creation, ownership or replay.

requirements.title: Role authority and platform roles
requirements.statement: Define role meanings, versions and assignable-role limits per domain. Organization privileges stay in the selected authorization detail. Explicitly configured platform roles may use the standard roles claim for the intended audience; they never imply cross-organization access. Attribute mappings cannot create authority.

requirements.title: Lifecycle and security suspension
requirements.statement: Use provisioning/active/suspended/deleted Organizations and invited/active/suspended/removed memberships. Serialize last-administrator checks. First-admin acceptance and activation are atomic; provisioning grants no business access. Global identity security suspension must succeed even for the last admin, while the affected organization requires explicit audited recovery.

requirements.title: Original authorization ceiling
requirements.statement: Capture and protect original client, target, identity, membership and role-version ceilings at authorization. Effective privileges are an intersection, never a union. Promotion, rejoin, reactivation or role expansion requires new authorization; refresh/exchange cannot manufacture consent or renew authentication freshness.

requirements.title: Exchange admission
requirements.statement: Accept one registered audience and one organization detail from an authenticated confidential client and an eligible local user access token. Bind current/original registration, root and DPoP key; require existing cross-audience policy. Refuse actor tokens, organization-token chaining, ID tokens and organization authority from client credentials.

requirements.title: Wire consistency
requirements.statement: Use the versioned project-controlled type, opaque external identifier, nonempty granted privileges and explicit access basis. Token response, JWT and authorized introspection agree. Issue a signed RFC 9068 access token for one audience with token_type DPoP, no organization refresh token, and lifetime bounded by 300 seconds and all parent/grant horizons.

requirements.title: Sender and authentication binding
requirements.statement: Validate the token and DPoP proof at each responsible AS/RS boundary; bind issuer, audience, registration, root, subject, key and expiry. Preserve original auth_time/acr/amr. Introspection authenticates the RS and returns cnf.jkt; the RS validates the presenting client proof and ath itself.

requirements.title: Online revocation
requirements.statement: Check root and authoritative organization, membership, role and administrative-grant state for every protected operation; do not reuse positive decisions. A check started after successful suspension completion rejects the revoked authority. Already admitted operations may finish. Unrelated organization changes do not revoke other memberships; global identity/client/root changes may.

requirements.title: Delegated management
requirements.statement: Authorize the acting user with a dedicated management audience, DPoP, scopes, original ceiling and current assignable-role policy in the mutation transaction. An admin can mutate only allowed members/roles in its organization, including checking roles removed. A read-only reconciliation credential gains no mutation, user-deletion or operator authority.

requirements.title: Explicit administrative access
requirements.statement: Authorize domain provisioning separately from membership. Business support access requires an explicit grant binding user, client, root, key, one organization, one audience, roles and reason, for at most 300 seconds and fresh original MFA within 300 seconds. No empty-privilege or global-role bypass is allowed.

requirements.title: Invitations
requirements.statement: Issue expiring, revocable, one-use invitation capabilities with 256 random bits stored as hashes; default lifetime 24 hours. Deliver via protected outbox. Accept only an authenticated POST with fresh recipient-address control, current inviter delegation and permitted organization/roles checked atomically. GET, email scanners, replay and invitation possession cannot activate or link an account.

requirements.title: Signup and recovery
requirements.statement: Provide policy-enabled self-registration, address verification and account recovery using the selected subject profile. Invitation acceptance for an unregistered recipient completes through this flow. Signup policy is independent of membership eligibility; recovery cannot evade suspension, take over an identity or revive an old grant.

requirements.title: Transactional mutations and replay
requirements.statement: Commit mutation, audit, outbox and replay receipt together or roll back. Require current representation preconditions for mutations, scope idempotency to actor/client registration/domain/operation and bind the complete semantic request. Recheck authority before replay; mismatched payloads conflict and lost responses do not cause a second mutation.

requirements.statement: Record actor, client registration, authority basis, reason, scope, request/correlation identity and state change without raw credentials, invitation secrets or excess profile data. Bound access/retention and protect integrity. Delivery retries are deduplicated and outbox delivery is never the source of revocation truth.

requirements.statement: Provide versioned, access-controlled, consistent snapshot exports of identities/subject correspondence, organizations, roles, memberships, invitations/status, ownership history and authorized audit. Include completeness counts/checksums and snapshot identity. Secret invitation tokens and password material are excluded from ordinary export; credential portability uses a separate protected process.

requirements.title: Migration and retirement
requirements.statement: Validate imports and credential compatibility; compare decisions and retain unresolved records. Freeze membership writes for final delta, select one authoritative writer/reader epoch, then invalidate old grants and reauthorize. Dual parsers must never union permissions or fall back to old authority. Retire application-specific projections/adapters only after acceptance and rollback readiness.

requirements.title: Restore and rollback
requirements.statement: Restoring storage requires a new non-rollbackable authority epoch, invalidation of pre-restore roots/tokens and reconciliation of permanent subject/organization ownership history before reactivation. Rollback reconciles new writes and invalidates both authority generations. A restored counter or old snapshot must never revive revoked access.

Show only eligible organizations/members/invitations. Unauthorized requests do not reveal whether another organization or identity exists; export authority is distinct from routine list authority.

requirements.title: Configuration and advertisement
requirements.statement: Keep the profile disabled until its dependency and acceptance gates pass. Advertise the exact RAR type only where accepted. Configuration changes are validated, versioned, audited and affect grants without expanding them. Do not advertise SCIM, AuthZEN, hierarchical membership, offline organization access or native-login selection from this implementation.

Aegaeon proves its AS/own-RS behavior; external enforcement and service availability are explicit deployment obligations.

delivery_policies.name: Standards conformance
delivery_policies.statement: Preserve all applicable OAuth/OIDC and component RFC requirements, including their roles, conditions and error behavior; define Organizations as a versioned Aegaeon profile in permitted extension points. Vendor API compatibility never overrides standards or weakens existing profiles.
delivery_policies.acceptance: Map each standard/project rule separately; exercise normal/error/disabled flows and preexisting profiles; verify advertised metadata and actual routes on the same release.

delivery_policies.name: General product capability
delivery_policies.statement: Deliver generic Environment-scoped membership, organization access, delegated administration, invitation/recovery, audit and migration for independent applications. Prioritize useful complete workflows and documented contracts over copying vendor-specific APIs or one customer business model. Preserve accepted identity/data/migration duties.
delivery_policies.acceptance: Demonstrate complete supported workflows for multiple organizations/roles/audiences with generic fixtures, documented limits, authorized export/import and recovery; retain availability/latency evidence. Competitive value is a product assessment, not a theorem or an unmeasured superiority claim.

delivery_policies.name: Secure defaults
delivery_policies.statement: Disable the extension until explicitly configured; after enablement default to deny absent authority. Require least privilege, original-grant ceilings, sender binding, bounded lifetimes, current-authority checks and explicit administrative access. No permissive cache/store-failure fallback, implicit global-role bypass or compatibility downgrade of mandatory security properties.
delivery_policies.acceptance: Exercise fresh install, explicit enablement, omitted/invalid settings and authority/provider failures. Configuration/migration must not silently widen prior authority or advertise unavailable functionality.

delivery_policies.name: Formal verification
delivery_policies.statement: Perform Organization-scoped formal verification with stated full domains and actual implementation correspondence. Establish isolation, non-amplification, lifecycle, replay/transaction and revocation properties, caller-established preconditions, actual supplier and artifact/composition obligations. Finite tests or abstract model success alone do not discharge the product claim.
delivery_policies.acceptance: Resolve concrete proof statements/tools/domains and actual caller/model/storage correspondence before evidence acceptance; preserve unknowns, failures and conditional results; final release/configuration must meet the existing assurance rules.

delivery_policies.name: Security tests and regression prevention
delivery_policies.statement: Execute threat-derived security tests as well as formal verification: cross-environment/domain/organization access, escalation, confused deputy, token/proof/invitation replay, malformed or duplicate inputs, races, cancellation/crash/retry and stale/failed authority. Add durable regressions and meaningful vulnerable-version or mutation controls for fixes; bind results to actual inputs/code/artifacts.
delivery_policies.acceptance: Retain positive legitimate workflows, negative authorization/security cases, concurrency/fault and suitable fuzz/sanitizer coverage. Evaluate review findings against actual code; a green aggregate job or unrelated rerun is insufficient.
